breakdown.description: The prompt substitutes the bending second moment I for the polar moment J in torsion formulas, even though solid circular shaft torsion is governed by J = π d^4/32.
breakdown.reason: The incomplete prompt incorrectly told the agent to use the bending second moment 'I = π d^4/64' for torsion calculations. The ground truth removes this error and uses the correct polar moment of inertia 'J = π d^4/32'. The generated specification successfully resolved this by correctly instructing to use the formula 'J = π d^4 / 32' and completely omitting the incorrect instruction to use 'I'.
